differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia (MCV 41 fL) with low hemoglobin in a young adult, likely from menstrual loss or pregnancy.

differential.name: Beta‑thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Marked microcytosis with relatively preserved hemoglobin and normal iron stores is classic for thalassemia minor.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Coexisting chronic pulmonary disease (emphysema, sleep apnea) can cause mild anemia with low reticulocyte response.

differential.name: Sideroblastic anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia with normal iron studies; consider if there is alcohol use or medication exposure.

differential.name: Lead poisoning
differential.rationale: Rare cause of microcytic anemia in adults; included due to low MPV flag and occupational exposure risk.
